what_this_proves: Every DataHub SDK call Antigen made during a complete, unmodified run of the live path documented in DEMO.md, against a real DataHub GMS. Each record carries the tool name, the exact request kwargs and the response returned by the server. Nothing here comes from antigen._testkit.InMemoryGateway — that in-memory double is the OFFLINE path only, and is not exercised at all in this file.

supersedes.why_both_are_kept: The 2026-08-08 capture is real, honestly-recorded evidence and is NOT deleted — but it predates the 2026-08-09 fixes, so it documents code Antigen no longer ships: its `search` calls request num_results=500 (the pre-fix paging bug), its commands are the pre-write-gate forms (`python -m antigen demo`, which the shipped CLI now refuses with exit 2 without --apply), and its cure banners predate the v1.2 convergence fix. It stays because it is the evidence for a claim this file cannot make: it is where you can see the live GMS CLAMP num_results=500 down to a 50-row page, which is the bug the fix responds to. THIS file is the canonical record of the code that ships.

environment.auth: metadata-service auth is DISABLED on `datahub docker quickstart`, so DATAHUB_GMS_TOKEN was empty for this run

how_captured.method: A sitecustomize.py recorder placed on PYTHONPATH — i.e. entirely OUTSIDE the project package. It wraps antigen.gateway.SdkGateway._call (the single seam through which every Agent Context Kit LangChain tool is invoked) and five base acryl-datahub DataHubGraph methods. No file in the repository was modified to produce this transcript.
how_captured.reset_between_cycles: The three cycles each need a freshly poisoned graph (verify.py --live runs its OWN scan+cure, and a cured entity keeps its injection-quarantined tag, which the sweep deliberately skips), so the flow was run three times with a full reset in between. The reset hard-deletes every dataset / KB document / antigen tag via DataHubGraph.hard_delete_entity, leaving what a fresh `datahub docker quickstart` has (urn:li:corpuser:datahub and urn:li:document:__system_shared_documents) — equivalent to the `datahub docker nuke` reset DEMO.md documents, without the image restart. The reset itself is NOT part of this transcript. The reset before cycle C did not fully converge: three KB documents were still in the search index after 120 s of polling, it said so on stderr, and that warning is left in docs/live-run.log verbatim. Those three are exactly why cycle C sweeps 78 entities rather than 75.
how_captured.truncation: Request kwargs are recorded verbatim. Strings longer than 400 characters are truncated with an explicit marker; lists longer than 25 items likewise. base_sdk responses (raw aspect objects) are trimmed to a 400-char preview — they are supporting evidence, not the judged tool surface. This applies to `searchResults` too: a 50-row page is recorded as its first 25 rows plus a '+N more items truncated' marker, so read page size off the `count` / `total` envelope fields and the requested `offset`, not off the row count. `pagination_proof` below is computed from these records.
how_captured.redaction: Tokens/API keys and the operator's home directory and username are replaced with placeholders. DATAHUB_GMS_TOKEN was empty (quickstart auth disabled), so no credential existed to leak.

phases.entity_count_note: 15, not the 17 the 2026-08-08 capture reported for the identical catalog, and the difference is DataHub's asynchronous index, not a different catalog. `search` enumerates 13 datasets + urn:li:corpuser:datahub + urn:li:document:__system_shared_documents = 15; the two KB documents seed_corpus.py plants are DOCUMENT entities that show up in `search` as well, but only once OpenSearch has indexed them. On 2026-08-08 they had landed before the sweep (17); here they had not (15). Both KB payloads were still found either way — the document sweep goes through search_documents/grep_documents, and the flagged-loci count is 15/15 in both runs. The same race is what made the 2026-08-08 verify.py --live attempt fail closed at 11/12. The two entities also account for `certified 2` here versus `certified 4` there: certify stamps the clean remainder of what `search` enumerated.

observed.part_b: skipped — langchain_anthropic / LLM key not installed in this capture environment; Part B never gates

phases.note: This run passed on the first attempt. The 2026-08-08 capture's first attempt FAILED closed at 'scan flagged 11/12 authored corpus loci' on the same search-index race described in phase A, and that failure is preserved verbatim in the archived pair (docs/live-run-2026-08-08.log) — a proof artifact that only ever shows the happy path is worth less. phases.purpose: paging at scale — prove SdkGateway._paged_urns actually pages against a real GMS, which no earlier capture could show

observed.seed_catalog: 73 datasets created (the 13 demo datasets + 60 clean padding datasets) + 6 lineage edges
observed.sweep: scanned 78 entities + 2 documents | 15 injection loci flagged | 2 hidden in zero-width Unicode | 13 via get_entities | 2 via grep_documents
observed.paging: every `search` enumeration in this phase took TWO pages: offset=0 then offset=50, envelope total=78. Under the pre-fix loop (num_results=500, stop when a page returns fewer than 500) the first page would have terminated the loop and entities 51-78 would have been reported clean without ever being read.

phases.why_read_only: `antigen scan` never mutates, so this cycle adds the paging evidence without writing a second, differently-shaped hero arc into the catalog.

pagination_proof.what_to_look_for: The 50-row page is the live GMS's own cap, not a client choice: the archived 2026-08-08 transcript asked for num_results=500 on all 11 of its `search` calls and every response came back `"count": 50`. The shipped loop now asks for 50 and advances `offset` by the number of rows actually returned. Every `search` / `search_documents` call in this file is listed below with its requested offset and the envelope the server answered with; the entries with offset > 0 are second pages, which only exist because the catalog was seeded past one page in phase C.

summary.search_documents_context: Driven from SdkGateway._document_urns() because the live grep_documents requires an explicit `urns` list — there is no 'grep the whole KB' mode. It is one of the 9 claimed tools and is counted in them.
summary.base_sdk_calls_are_not_agent_tools: DataHubGraph.emit / emit_mcp / get_aspect / exists are base acryl-datahub operations (catalog seeding, structured-property definitions, tag-entity creation, the editableSchemaMetadata overlay). They are counted separately so the '9 Agent Context Kit tools' claim stays exactly true. Phase C seeds 60 extra padding datasets, so its base_sdk emit counts are correspondingly higher than a 13-dataset cycle's.
